author: Simple History
description:
Take command of a platoon of Sherman tanks and fight across famous WWII battlefields. Give orders to your crew and coordinate with other units on the tactical map. Play now: https://tinyurl.com/SimpleHistorySherman

In WWII, tank crews didn’t always wait for upgrades — they improvised. Shermans in the Pacific were covered in spikes to stop soldiers climbing aboard with explosives, while crews added wood, spare tracks, and even concrete for protection. Strange battlefield solutions that sometimes worked… and sometimes wrecked the tank.
